drhp.business: The Company is engaged in the business of real estate activities, involving developing, leasing, constructing and redeveloping residential and commercial projects in India, primarily in Mumbai. It operates as a single operating segment (Real Estate Business), with reported Residential and Commercial Real Estate segments, and its portfolio spans redevelopment-led projects across established Mumbai micro-markets.

drhp.expansion: The Company's running project portfolio increased to approximately ₹2,500 crore of GDV, up from approximately ₹400 crore two years earlier, with six new projects added during FY26 adding combined GDV of approximately ₹900 crore. It received Commencement Certificates for Shraddha Phoenix in Mulund East and Shraddha Paradise Enclave in Mulund West, moving these projects closer to execution. The current pipeline comprises 9 ongoing and 8 upcoming projects across Mumbai micro-markets. The Company also added Avyukta Imperial in Matunga East to its premium housing portfolio, continuing its transition towards larger-format premium residences, and completed and delivered Shraddha Priva in Mulund West during the year.

demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- Redevelopment has emerged as an important structural opportunity in densely populated cities where availability of vacant land is limited, particularly relevant to Mumbai given ageing housing societies and constrained land availability.
- The Indian residential real estate market is shifting from volume-led growth towards value-led growth and premiumization, with homebuyers preferring better-located properties, larger homes, improved amenities and higher construction quality.
- Increasing importance of organized developers with established execution capabilities, access to capital and strong customer relationships; RERA-driven transparency has strengthened customer confidence and encouraged industry consolidation.
- Infrastructure development (Metro expansion, road infrastructure, Mumbai Trans Harbour Link, Coastal Road) is improving connectivity across Mumbai and the MMR, strengthening linkages between established residential locations and emerging growth corridors.
- Lower financing costs following the RBI's policy repo rate reduction can support housing affordability and contribute to improved residential demand.
- The Company's running project portfolio increased to approximately ₹2,500 crore of GDV, compared with approximately ₹400 crore two years earlier.
- During FY26, the Company added six new projects with combined GDV of approximately ₹900 crore, strengthening its development pipeline and future revenue visibility.
- The Company's current development pipeline comprises 9 ongoing projects and 8 upcoming projects, providing visibility across multiple Mumbai micro-markets.

capex_expansion.title: Expansion (RHP)
capex_expansion.body: The Company's running project portfolio increased to approximately ₹2,500 crore of GDV, up from approximately ₹400 crore two years earlier, with six new projects added during FY26 adding combined GDV of approximately ₹900 crore. It received Commencement Certificates for Shraddha Phoenix in Mulund East and Shraddha Paradise Enclave in Mulund West, moving these projects closer to execution. The current pipeline comprises 9 ongoing and 8 upcoming projects across Mumbai micro-markets. The Company also added Avyukta Imperial in Matunga East to its premium housing portfolio, continuing its transition towards larger-format premium residences, and completed and delivered Shraddha Priva in Mulund West during the year.

moat.title: Strengths (RHP)
moat.body:
- distribution: Redevelopment specialisation across established Mumbai micro-markets — evidence: portfolio expanded across Bhandup, Mulund, Kanjurmarg, Vikhroli, Borivali, Kandivali, Jogeshwari, Thane and other locations
- scale: Rapidly expanding development pipeline — evidence: running project portfolio increased to approximately ₹2,500 crore of GDV, compared with approximately ₹400 crore two years earlier, with nine ongoing and eight upcoming projects

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Rising costs of construction materials, labour and other inputs may put pressure on project margins and profitability.
- Any increase in interest rates, changes in lending conditions or reduction in housing affordability could affect customers' purchasing decisions and overall demand.
- The Company faces competition from established and emerging real estate developers, which may result in pricing pressure and higher marketing and customer acquisition costs.
- Delays in obtaining approvals, changes in government policies and regulations, availability of land, project execution challenges and potential delays in construction may adversely affect project timelines and cash flows.
- Market conditions may change due to broader economic factors including inflation, employment levels, interest rates and consumer confidence.
- The Company's operations remain focused on the domestic residential real estate market and are primarily influenced by developments in the Indian economy and the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, making performance dependent on a single regional market.
- The Company continued its prudent debt management approach, but looking into the ongoing projects there was an increase in overall debt levels.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Remain focused on redevelopment-led growth across Mumbai and the MMR, particularly in established residential locations where land availability is constrained.
- Continue to increase exposure to premium and larger-format housing, transitioning the portfolio from 1RK and 1BHK formats towards 2BHK, 3BHK and 4BHK residences.
- Focus on timely project execution, efficient capital deployment, strengthening customer and society relationships, improving collections, and selectively adding projects that meet the Company's location, demand and return criteria.
- Continue prudent project selection, effective cost management, timely execution and disciplined financial management.
- Explore opportunities for expanding the commercial real estate portfolio in line with market demand.
